plan.subject: Adolescent depression

queries.query: ("adolescent depression" OR "youth depression" OR "teen depression" OR "depressed adolescents" OR "depression in adolescents" OR "pediatric depression" OR "adolescent depressive symptoms" OR "adolescent major depression") AND (treatment OR psychotherapy OR intervention OR therapy OR outcome)

queries.query: ("adolescent depression" OR "youth depression" OR "teen depression" OR "depressed adolescents" OR "depression in adolescents" OR "pediatric depression" OR "adolescent depressive symptoms" OR "adolescent major depression") AND ("cognitive behavioral therapy" OR CBT OR "behavioral activation" OR "interpersonal psychotherapy" OR "IPT-A")

queries.query: ("adolescent depression" OR "youth depression" OR "teen depression" OR "depressed adolescents" OR "depression in adolescents" OR "pediatric depression" OR "adolescent depressive symptoms" OR "adolescent major depression") AND (SSRI OR fluoxetine OR escitalopram OR sertraline OR antidepressant)

queries.query: ("adolescent depression" OR "youth depression" OR "teen depression" OR "depressed adolescents" OR "depression in adolescents" OR "pediatric depression" OR "adolescent depressive symptoms" OR "adolescent major depression") AND ("combination therapy" OR "combined treatment" OR "fluoxetine plus CBT" OR "medication plus psychotherapy" OR "multimodal treatment")

queries.query: ("adolescent depression" OR "youth depression" OR "teen depression" OR "depressed adolescents" OR "depression in adolescents" OR "pediatric depression" OR "adolescent depressive symptoms" OR "adolescent major depression") AND (suicidality OR "suicide risk" OR "suicidal ideation" OR self-harm OR "safety monitoring")

queries.query: ("adolescent depression" OR "youth depression" OR "teen depression" OR "depressed adolescents" OR "depression in adolescents" OR "pediatric depression" OR "adolescent depressive symptoms" OR "adolescent major depression") AND ("digital intervention" OR "internet-based CBT" OR "mobile app" OR mHealth OR teletherapy)

queries.query: ("adolescent depression" OR "youth depression" OR "teen depression" OR "depressed adolescents" OR "depression in adolescents" OR "pediatric depression" OR "adolescent depressive symptoms" OR "adolescent major depression") AND ("school-based prevention" OR "school-based intervention" OR "universal prevention" OR "indicated prevention" OR classroom)

queries.query: ("adolescent depression" OR "youth depression" OR "teen depression" OR "depressed adolescents" OR "depression in adolescents" OR "pediatric depression" OR "adolescent depressive symptoms" OR "adolescent major depression") AND ("depression screening" OR PHQ-A OR "Mood and Feelings Questionnaire" OR MFQ OR "Children's Depression Inventory")
queries.rationale: Targets screening and measurement instruments commonly used to identify and monitor depressive symptoms in adolescents.

queries.query: ("adolescent depression" OR "youth depression" OR "teen depression" OR "depressed adolescents" OR "depression in adolescents" OR "pediatric depression" OR "adolescent depressive symptoms" OR "adolescent major depression") AND ("suicide screening" OR "suicide risk screening" OR ASQ OR C-SSRS OR "risk assessment")

queries.query: ("adolescent depression" OR "youth depression" OR "teen depression" OR "depressed adolescents" OR "depression in adolescents" OR "pediatric depression" OR "adolescent depressive symptoms" OR "adolescent major depression") AND (anxiety OR "comorbid anxiety" OR "anxiety disorder" OR internalizing OR transdiagnostic)

queries.query: ("adolescent depression" OR "youth depression" OR "teen depression" OR "depressed adolescents" OR "depression in adolescents" OR "pediatric depression" OR "adolescent depressive symptoms" OR "adolescent major depression") AND ("randomized controlled trial" OR RCT OR "meta-analysis" OR "systematic review" OR "effect size")
queries.rationale: Surfaces higher-level evidence and trial reports aligned with the reader's preference for stronger evidence standards.

queries.query: ("adolescent depression" OR "youth depression" OR "teen depression" OR "depressed adolescents" OR "depression in adolescents" OR "pediatric depression" OR "adolescent depressive symptoms" OR "adolescent major depression") AND (implementation OR "implementation science" OR feasibility OR uptake OR fidelity)
queries.rationale: Targets evidence on whether effective interventions can actually be delivered and sustained in real-world adolescent settings.

plan.coverage_notes: The plan emphasizes clinically actionable evidence for adolescent depression across psychotherapy, medication, combination treatment, suicide risk, assessment, prevention, digital care, and implementation. It also includes broader recall-safety queries to ensure coverage of new trials and reviews while keeping the anchor tightly adolescent-depression-specific. Neuroimaging, biomarkers, and adult-only depression work are deliberately not targeted because the profile prioritizes outpatient treatment relevance over mechanistic neuroscience.
